answer_1.quote: We define the task of lateral thinking for LLMs, formulated as a multiple-choice QA with a sentence- and word-level puzzles.

answer_2.quote: As accuracy is a fair evaluation metric for the MCQA format and it has been adopted by many popular commonsense reasoning tasks, we evaluate model performance using two accuracy metrics: Instance-based Accuracy ... Group-based Accuracy ...

answer_4.quote: To assess the upper bound performance on BRAINTEASER, we randomly sample 102 questions from it and invite three experts annotator to solve the test.
